function: Channel prediction: network maps estimated historical uplink cascaded channels (10 frames) to the next 5 downlink frames of the RIS-aided LEO satellite FDD link (p. 3, 4).
system: Passive reflecting RIS (4x64 UPA) assisting FDD LEO satellite (4x8 UPA), 4 single-antenna near-field users; uplink 9.9 GHz, downlink 10.1 GHz (p. 1, 2, 4).
method: Signal-informed network (SIN): complex frequency-domain MLP, multi-branch phase-aware module, deep-supervision encoder-decoder; supervised training with L1 loss and frequency-domain auxiliary loss, 50 epochs (p. 3-4).
data_channel: Own simulator after [12]: Rician LOS plus scatterers, hybrid near/far-field; only path loss and shadow fading follow 3GPP TR 38.811; dataset size not stated (p. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Single simulation setup (M=4x8, N=4x64, K=4, 9.9/10.1 GHz); uplink SNR swept, 0 dB for the frame-wise test; no other scenario tested (p. 4-5).
baselines: Learned only: LSTM [8], CNN-LSTM [9], TCN [10], Transformer [11]; no non-learned predictor compared (p. 4).
metrics: NMSE versus uplink SNR and versus prediction frame; training loss versus epochs; parameters and FLOPs (Figs. 3-5, Table I) (p. 4-5).
complexity: Table I: SIN has 3.315 M parameters and 7.859 G FLOPs, versus Transformer 1.310 M and 15.61 G; LSTM 290.2 M (p. 5).
openness: none; no code or data link (p. 1-5).
q1_support: p. 4: "The parameters of path loss and shadow fading follow the 3GPP TR 38.811 protocol"; only path loss and shadow fading come from 3GPP, while the small-scale channel is the authors' own model after [12] (p. 2).
q2_support: p. 5: "the uplink SNR is set to 0 dB in the test stage"; Figs. 3-4 only sweep SNR and prediction frame, with one array, RIS, user and band setup (p. 4); no new scenario or adaptation is reported.
q3_support: p. 4: "We compare the proposed SIN with state-of-the-art benchmarks"; the four benchmarks (LSTM, CNN-LSTM, TCN, Transformer) are all learned, and no non-learned predictor is compared.
q4_support: p. 5: "Table I summarizes the number of parameters and floating point of operations (FLOPs) of different network models"; SIN has 3.315 M parameters and 7.859 G FLOPs.
q5_support: p. 4: "In simulation setups, we set"; the data come from the authors' own simulator, and no code, data link or DOI is given anywhere in the letter.
notes: Included as area 2: channel prediction is the learned function, and the LEO setting does not make it area 6, which covers resource, power and beam control. RIS is passive and reflecting (p. 1-2). q1 is borderline: only path loss and shadow fading follow TR 38.811 (p. 4, footnote 1 on p. 2), the small-scale fading is the authors' own model after [12], so it counts as a custom simulator; the reviewer should confirm. q3: all four benchmarks are learned and no non-learned predictor is compared. The Table I values (3.315 M, 7.859 G) were read from the image of page 5. Dataset size and train/test split are not given.
